The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No.780/2007 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961 registered at Police Station Welcome and the subsequent proceedings emanating therefrom on the ground of settlement.
2. Pursuant to the order passed by the Predecessor Bench on 12th October, 2023, amended memo of parties has been handed over in Court today by the petitioner and the same is taken on record.
3. The petitioner is the husband of the respondent no.2.
The marriage of the petitioner and the respondent no.2 was solemnized on 11th April, 2005 as per Muslim rites and ceremonies.

sentences.text: Now the parties have settled all their disputes before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts in terms of Settlement Agreement dated 24th June, 2013, which has been filed as Annexure P-2 to the petition.
6. In terms of the settlement, the parties have agreed to live together peacefully.

7. Issue notice.
8.

Notice is accepted by the learned APP appearing on behalf of the State and by the respondent no.2.
9.
The respondent no.2 is present in Court and has been identified by the Investigating Officer (IO).
She informs the Court that she has settled the matter of her own free will and without any coercion and confirms that she has been living in her matrimonial home.
She further states that she has no objection to quashing of the FIR.
10. The petitioner is also present in Court and has been identified by his counsel.
He affirms the statement of the respondent no.2 and undertakes to abide by the terms of settlement arrived at between the parties.

11. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioner being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.

Hence, it would be in the interest of justice to quash the aforementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
12.
Consequently, the FIR No.780/2007 at Police Station Welcome and the proceedings pursuant thereto are quashed.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 14/12/2023 at 23:14:26 13.
The petition stands disposed of.
